Container.Name: maintainerr
Container.Overview: Maintainerr makes managing your media library easy. Create custom rules with parameters across Plex, Jellyfin, Emby, Radarr, Sonarr, Seerr and Tautulli, surface matching media in a collection for a configurable number of days, and automatically handle the cleanup.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: plex jellyfin emby radarr sonarr seerr tautulli library cleanup media manager
Container.Requires: The container runs as user 99:100 (nobody:users). If the first start logs permission errors, run: chown -R 99:100 /mnt/user/appdata/maintainerr
Container.DonateText: Support Maintainerr development on Open Collective

Branch.TagDescription: Pre-release builds from the development branch

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: HTTP port for the web interface.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Persistent storage for the Maintainerr database and logs.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone used for rule schedules and logs, e.g. Europe/Brussels.

Config.Name: Base Path
Config.Description: Set only when serving Maintainerr from a subdirectory behind a reverse proxy, e.g. /maintainerr.

Config.Name: UI Hostname
Config.Description: Address the web server listens on inside the container. Leave empty for 0.0.0.0; set :: for IPv6.

Config.Name: GitHub Token
Config.Description: Optional GitHub Personal Access Token for higher API rate limits when checking for updates (60/hr without, 5000/hr with).
